tlgrcli-tlgr-tlgr.description: Read and act on a personal Telegram account from the terminal with the tlgr CLI (MTProto user account, not a bot). Use when the user wants to check unread Telegram chats, read or search message history, send, reply to, edit, forward or schedule messages, manage chats, groups, channels, contacts, folders, reactions, polls, media or stories, or receive Telegram events through a webhook. Every command answers in JSON with stable exit codes.
